description: An amateur deepfake video has gone viral in bypoll-bound Munugode Assembly Constituency, indicating the future threat to the elections due to deepfak
body_lead: HYDERABAD: An amateur deepfake video has gone viral in bypoll-bound Munugode Assembly Constituency, indicating the future threat to the elections due to deepfakes. In a video of BJP candidate and former MLA Komatireddy Raj Gopal Reddy saying BJP will lose in the polls has his audio mimicked. Based on the complaint received, Telangana Chief Electoral Officer has got the video verified and found it to be fake. The video of Raj Gopal addressing a press conference has also his audio mimicked. In the fake video, Reddy says, âThe TRS graph is increasing, and his is decreasing.
